answer: Divergent Path Witnessing: each identity must publish a signed, monotonically advancing chain of local environment readings (timber moisture, tundra ground temperature, nectar sugar concentration) tied to its physical host. Clones replay identical chains and cannot fork them, since divergence requires independent sensors. Validators reject any two chains sharing a genesis but diverging later, slashing both. An attacker running N clones pays N separate sensor deployments plus a full hardware kit per identity, not just N keys.
